name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2026-04-03, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
